## Problem and result

Describe the user problem, what changes, and any related issue (for example, Fixes #123).

## Validation

- [ ] Ran the relevant build and automated checks, or explained why they do not apply.
- [ ] Updated focused tests and documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] Removed private information from screenshots, recordings, and logs.

List commands or manual steps actually performed, their results, and the Windows/display environment when relevant. Mark checks you could not run as **Not tested**. For capture or sharing behavior, distinguish local observation from remote viewer results.

## Limitations

List remaining issues, compatibility concerns, or follow-up work.
